name: inkstrip-manhwa-studio-desktop
description: Inkstrip Manhwa Studio for Windows: offline manhwa chapter, raster, composition and lettering editor.

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never
